title: Error-detected surgery on Iceberg codes
summary: We construct explicit error-detecting surgery gadgets---small systems of auxiliary qubits and checks---for the high-rate Iceberg codes $[[2N,2N-2,2]]$, to perform fault-detected measurements of logical Pauli products. The construction follows the perspective of surgery as the gauging of a logical operator, regarded as a symmetry of the code.
